items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: I don't know what the humbug they had, Miss Miley and Lawrence Down at Lutches

ctx.x: You see, I don't know what the humbug they had, Miss Miley and Lawrence Down at Lutches, that was the first beginning before I even started to go working for them. See, so I don't know, they couldn't get along with some another damn day, see. And the fellow Melvin Frank, he's dead. So Melvin Frank, come and hired me and Dede, come down there to work, see. Yes. And we go down there to work. Well, Edna Francis was living a piano player. Well, that's when my sister left to go away. I guess on the boat, we'll take…
